The average prices retrieved from the Shopping Prices Comparison Tool are calculated by first determining the weighted arithmetic mean of the price quotes collected for each item  for the latest January, where the weighted mean is used to reflect the relative popularity of each individual priced item. Average prices for the remaining months are then calculated by multiplying the current month’s Consumer Prices Index, including owner occupiers' housing costs (CPIH) item index growth rate since January, with the previously calculated January average price.  The CPIH is very similar to the Consumer Prices Index (CPI), but includes the costs associated with owning, maintaining and living in one’s own home. The items in the “Shopping Prices Comparison Tool” are updated in March of each year to coincide with the revision of items in the United Kingdom's inflation basket. Users should be aware that the average price estimates presented are experimental, that is, they are still in the testing phase and are not fully developed.
